form_name: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
rule: Original due date for calendar-year individual returns
description: File a 2025 Form 1040 or 1040-SR and pay any tax due. Form 4868 gives an automatic 6-month extension to file (not to pay).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, April 15

form_name: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return - automatic 2-month extension abroad
filer: U.S. citizens/residents living and working outside the U.S. and Puerto Rico
rule: Automatic 2-month extension for taxpayers abroad on April 15
extension_form: Form 4868 (for the further extension to Oct 15)
description: If you are a U.S. citizen or resident alien living and working outside the U.S. and Puerto Rico, file and pay by June 15. File Form 4868 for 4 additional months to file (to Oct 15); this does not extend time to pay.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, June 15

form_name: Estimated Tax for Individuals - 1st installment
rule: First 2026 estimated tax installment
description: Pay the first installment of 2026 estimated tax if income tax is not paid through withholding.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, April 15

form_name: Estimated Tax for Individuals - 2nd installment
rule: Second 2026 estimated tax installment
description: Pay the second installment of 2026 estimated tax.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, June 15

form_name: Estimated Tax for Individuals - 3rd installment
rule: Third 2026 estimated tax installment
description: Pay the third installment of 2026 estimated tax.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, September 15

form_name: Estimated Tax for Individuals - 4th (final) installment
rule: Final 2025 estimated tax installment, due January 2026
description: Final installment of 2025 estimated tax. Not required if the 2025 return is filed and all tax paid by February 2, 2026.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, January 15

form_name: U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return
rule: Original due date for calendar-year C corporations
description: File a 2025 calendar year Form 1120 and pay any tax due. Form 7004 gives an automatic 6-month extension.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, April 15

form_name: Corporate estimated income tax - 1st installment
rule: First 2026 corporate estimated tax installment
description: Deposit the first installment of 2026 estimated income tax.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, April 15

form_name: Corporate estimated income tax - 2nd installment
rule: Second 2026 corporate estimated tax installment
description: Deposit the second installment of 2026 estimated income tax.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, June 15

form_name: Corporate estimated income tax - 3rd installment
rule: Third 2026 corporate estimated tax installment
description: Deposit the third installment of 2026 estimated income tax.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, September 15

form_name: Corporate estimated income tax - 4th installment
rule: Fourth 2026 corporate estimated tax installment
description: Deposit the fourth installment of 2026 estimated income tax.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, December 15

form_name: U.S. Return of Partnership Income
rule: Original due date for calendar-year partnerships
description: File a 2025 calendar year Form 1065 and provide each partner a Schedule K-1 (and K-3 if applicable). Form 7004 gives an automatic 6-month extension.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, March 16

form_name: U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation
rule: Original due date for calendar-year S corporations
description: File a 2025 calendar year Form 1120-S and pay any tax due; provide each shareholder a Schedule K-1 (and K-3 if applicable). Form 7004 gives an automatic 6-month extension.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, March 16

form_name: Election by a Small Business Corporation
rule: Election to be treated as an S corporation beginning with calendar year 2026
description: File Form 2553 to elect S corporation treatment beginning with calendar year 2026. A late-filed election takes effect for 2027 instead.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, March 16

form_name: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts
filer: U.S. persons with foreign financial accounts exceeding $10,000 aggregate
rule: Annual FBAR due date, with automatic extension
description: FinCEN Form 114 (FBAR) for calendar year 2025 is due April 15, 2026. FinCEN grants an automatic extension to October 15, 2026 for filers who miss the April deadline - no extension request is required.
authority: FinCEN: "Filers ... have an automatic extension up to October 15" (rule confirmed via FinCEN's official Due Date Clarification notice, applying the same April 15 original / October 15 automatic-extension pattern to the current filing season).

form_name: Annual Return To Report Transactions With Foreign Trusts and Receipt of Certain Foreign Gifts
filer: U.S. persons with reportable foreign trust transactions or large foreign gifts
rule: Rides the individual income tax return due date (calendar-year individual filer)
extension_form: Form 4868 (or the filer's applicable extension form)
description: Form 3520 for a calendar-year individual is due April 15, 2026, the same day as the income tax return. U.S. citizens/residents living and working abroad may get an automatic extension to June 15, 2026; if an extension of time to file the income tax return is granted, Form 3520 is due no later than October 15, 2026.
authority: IRS Instructions for Form 3520: "a U.S. person's Form 3520 is due on the 15th day of the 4th month following the end of such person's tax year"; extended to October 15 if the income tax return is extended.

form_name: Annual Information Return of Foreign Trust With a U.S. Owner
filer: Foreign trusts with a U.S. owner (filed by the trustee)
rule: Original due date is the 15th day of the 3rd month after the trust's tax year end (calendar-year trust)
description: Form 3520-A for a calendar-year foreign trust is due the 15th day of the 3rd month after the trust's tax year end - March 15, 2026, which falls on a Sunday, so the practical due date is March 16, 2026.
authority: IRS Instructions for Form 3520-A: "Form 3520-A is due by the 15th day of the 3rd month after the end of the foreign trust's tax year."

form_name: Information Return of U.S. Persons With Respect to Certain Foreign Corporations
filer: U.S. persons with certain interests in foreign corporations
rule: Rides the filer's income tax return due date, including extensions
extension_form: Same extension as the filer's underlying return
description: Form 5471 has no independent due date - it is attached to and filed by the due date (including extensions) of the filer's income tax return (or applicable partnership/exempt-org return).
authority: IRS Instructions for Form 5471: "Attach Form 5471 to your income tax return ... and file both by the due date (including extensions) for that return."

form_name: Information Return of a 25% Foreign-Owned U.S. Corporation or a Foreign Corporation Engaged in a U.S. Trade or Business
filer: 25%-foreign-owned U.S. corporations and foreign corporations engaged in a U.S. trade or business
rule: Rides the filer's income tax return due date, including extensions
extension_form: Form 7004 (or the filer's applicable extension form)
description: Form 5472 has no independent due date - it is attached to and filed by the due date (including extensions) of the reporting corporation's income tax return.
authority: IRS Instructions for Form 5472: "File Form 5472 as an attachment to the reporting corporation's income tax return by the due date (including extensions) of that return."

form_name: Wage and Tax Statement - furnish to employees
rule: Furnish 2025 Form W-2 copies to employees
description: Furnish employees their 2025 Form W-2 (January 31 falls on a Saturday, so the due date moves to the next business day).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Wage and Tax Statement - file with the Social Security Administration
rule: File 2025 Forms W-2 with Form W-3 with the SSA
description: File Copy A of all 2025 Forms W-2 with Form W-3 with the Social Security Administration.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Nonemployee Compensation
rule: File with the IRS and furnish to recipients
description: File Form 1099-NEC for nonemployee compensation paid in 2025 and furnish copies to recipients (February 2, since January 31 falls on a Saturday).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Information returns - furnish to recipients
rule: Furnish most 2025 Form 1099 statements to recipients
description: Furnish recipients most 2025 Form 1099 information statements (dividends, interest, rents, royalties, retirement distributions, etc.).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Broker/barter, real estate, and certain MISC payments - furnish to recipients
rule: Furnish these specific 1099 types to recipients
description: Furnish recipients 2025 Form 1099-B, Form 1099-S, and substitute payments or attorney gross proceeds reported on Form 1099-MISC boxes 8/10.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, February 17

form_name: Information returns - file with the IRS on paper
rule: File most 2025 Form 1099s with the IRS on paper
description: File most 2025 Forms 1099 (other than 1099-NEC) with the IRS on paper by March 2, 2026 (February 28 falls on a Saturday in some years; confirm current-year weekend adjustment).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, March 2

form_name: Information returns - file with the IRS electronically
rule: Electronic filing due date with the IRS
description: File Forms 1097, 1098, 1099 (except 1099-NEC), 3921, 3922, and W-2G electronically with the IRS by March 31, 2026.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), General Tax Calendar, March 31

form_name: Employer's QUARTERLY Federal Tax Return - 4th quarter 2025
rule: Quarterly return, last day of month following quarter end
description: File Form 941 for the fourth quarter of 2025 (February 2, 2026, if all quarterly taxes were deposited timely; otherwise January 31 wage-related due date rules under Pub. 509 apply).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Employer's QUARTERLY Federal Tax Return - 1st quarter 2026
rule: Quarterly return, last day of month following quarter end
description: File Form 941 for the first quarter of 2026.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, April 30

form_name: Employer's QUARTERLY Federal Tax Return - 2nd quarter 2026
rule: Quarterly return, last day of month following quarter end
description: File Form 941 for the second quarter of 2026.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, July 31

authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, October 31

form_name: Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return
rule: Annual FUTA return for 2025
description: File Form 940 for 2025 (February 2, 2026, if all FUTA tax was deposited timely).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Employer's Annual Federal Tax Return for Agricultural Employees
rule: Annual return for 2025
description: File Form 943 for 2025 (February 2, 2026, if all tax was deposited timely).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Employer's ANNUAL Federal Tax Return
filer: Certain small employers approved to file annually instead of Form 941
rule: Annual return for 2025
description: File Form 944 for 2025 (February 2, 2026, if all tax was deposited timely).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Annual Return of Withheld Federal Income Tax
filer: Payers of nonpayroll amounts (pensions, gambling winnings, backup withholding, etc.)
rule: Annual return for 2025
description: File Form 945 to report nonpayroll withholding for 2025 (February 2, 2026, if all tax was deposited timely).
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, February 2

form_name: Quarterly Federal Excise Tax Return - 1st quarter 2026
rule: Quarterly return, last day of month following quarter end
description: File Form 720 for the first quarter of 2026 and pay the tax due.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Excise Tax Calendar, April 30

form_name: Quarterly Federal Excise Tax Return - 2nd quarter 2026
rule: Quarterly return, last day of month following quarter end
description: File Form 720 for the second quarter of 2026 and pay the tax due.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Excise Tax Calendar, July 31

form_name: Heavy Highway Vehicle Use Tax Return
rule: Standard annual filing for vehicles first used in July (the start of the tax period)
description: File Form 2290 and pay the tax for vehicles first used on the road in July 2026 (the standard full tax-period case). Vehicles first used in other months follow their own last-day-of-following-month due date under Pub. 509's monthly table, not yet fully built into this calendar.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Excise Tax Calendar (Instructions for Form 2290)

form_name: Annual Return/Report of Employee Benefit Plan
rule: Original due date for calendar-year plans
description: File Form 5500 or 5500-EZ for the 2025 calendar plan year. Form 5558 extends the deadline to October 15, 2026.
authority: IRS Pub. 509 (2026), Employer's Tax Calendar, July 31
